goal: Inspect the implemented voice-to-Codex boundary and report whether its schemas, validator, runner, and focused tests are present and remain read-only.
constraints: Do not modify files, services, configuration, repositories, or external state.
Do not inspect secrets, credentials, raw audio, or speech transcripts.
Base findings only on the allowed repository paths.
deliverable: A bounded structured result summarizing the boundary and its verification evidence.
acceptance_checks: Confirm that only read-only Codex execution is exposed.
Confirm that task input is schema-validated and canonicalized before execution.
Confirm that focused negative tests cover forbidden raw transcript fields and missing confirmation.
